# DevXchange

DevXchange is a developer-first marketplace for production-ready software.

## What the site contains

- Marketplace listings for Software, Web, AI, Developer, Blockchain and Design.
- Developer profiles, product pages, licensing information, trust/verification information and marketplace FAQs.
- Buyer and seller account areas that are intentionally excluded from public indexing.

## Trust model

Verification levels run from 0 (Unverified) to 5 (DevXchange Certified). A badge represents recorded checks for a specific product version. Unautomated checks are shown as “Not yet checked”. Badges cannot be purchased.

## Licensing

Listings use Personal, Commercial, Extended or Enterprise terms. The exact listing license controls permitted and forbidden use.

## Data policy for crawlers

The public catalog is factual. If no approved listings exist, the site says so rather than inventing products, reviews, sales or user counts.

## Canonical site

https://shalimoosavi.github.io/DevXchange/
